cases.translation: Jesus Christ is the Word of life.
cases.explain: Слово is the predicate nominative following the verb быть (to be, implied), so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Мы возвещаем о том, что слышали, что видели своими глазами, о ___ жизни.
cases.translation: We proclaim what we heard, what we saw with our own eyes, concerning the Word of life.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about, concerning) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Мы видели ее, о чем и свидетельствуем вам о вечной ___.
cases.translation: We saw it, and we testify and tell you about the eternal life.
cases.explain: The preposition о in some contexts can govern the genitive; more commonly here it indicates 'life' in a partitive sense—the genitive of the object after возвещаем.

cases.sentence: Мы говорим вам о том, что сами видели и слышали, чтобы и вы тоже присоединились и имели общение с нами, а наше общение с ___ и Его Сыном Иисусом Христом.
cases.translation: We tell you what we ourselves have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us, and our fellowship is with the Father and His Son Jesus Christ.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governing companionship takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Об этом мы и пишем для того, чтобы радость наша была полной, ходите во ___.
cases.translation: We write this so that our joy may be complete. Walk in the light.
cases.explain: The preposition во (in) indicating location/manner governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Если мы говорим, что имеем общение с Ним, но сами ходим во ___, то мы лжем.
cases.translation: If we say we have fellowship with him but walk in the darkness, we lie.
cases.explain: The preposition во (in) with the prepositional case indicates location or condition.

cases.sentence: Но если мы ходим во свете, как и Он во свете, то мы имеем общение друг с другом, и кровь Его Сына Иисуса очищает нас от всякого ___.
cases.translation: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanses us from all sin.
cases.explain: The verb очищать (to cleanse) with the preposition от (from) governs the genitive case—cleansing from sin.

cases.sentence: Если мы признаем наши ___, то Он простит их нам и очистит нас от всякой неправедности.
cases.translation: If we confess our sins, He will forgive them and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
cases.explain: The verb признавать (to confess) is transitive and takes the accusative plural case for its direct object.

reading.question: Who is described as the Word of life?
reading.explain: The opening statement identifies Иисус Христос as the Слово жизни (Word of life).

reading.ru: Мы возвещаем вам о вечной жизни, которая была у Отца, и которая была явлена нам.
reading.question: Where was the eternal life before it was revealed to the apostles?
reading.explain: The text states 'о вечной жизни, которая была у Отца' (the eternal life which was with the Father).

reading.ru: Бог — это свет, и в нем нет никакой тьмы.
reading.question: How is God described in terms of light and darkness?
options: God is light and contains no darkness at all
God controls both light and darkness equally
God is sometimes light and sometimes darkness
God created light but not darkness
reading.correct: God is light and contains no darkness at all
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'Бог — это свет, и в нем нет никакой тьмы' (God is light, and in him is no darkness at all).

reading.ru: Но если мы ходим во свете, как и Он во свете, то мы имеем общение друг с другом.
reading.question: What happens when we walk in the light as God does?
options: We have fellowship with one another
We gain the power to judge others
We no longer need to pray
reading.correct: We have fellowship with one another
reading.explain: The verse states 'то мы имеем общение друг с другом' (then we have fellowship with one another).

reading.ru: Если мы заявляем о том, что мы безгрешны, то обманываем самих себя, и в нас нет истины.
reading.question: What happens if we claim to be sinless?
options: We deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us
God will believe us and forgive us
reading.correct: We deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us
reading.explain: The text clearly states 'то обманываем самих себя, и в нас нет истины' (we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us).

reading.ru: Если же мы признаем наши грехи, то Он простит их нам и очистит нас от всякой неправедности, потому что Он верен и справедлив.
reading.question: What is the result of confessing our sins?
options: He will forgive them and cleanse us from all unrighteousness
All our earthly problems will disappear
We will never face temptation again
reading.correct: He will forgive them and cleanse us from all unrighteousness
reading.explain: The verse states 'то Он простит их нам и очистит нас от всякой неправедности' (He will forgive them and cleanse us from all unrighteousness).
